target.queryText: SELECT at*1000 AS time, rule || ': ' || coalesce(observed,'?') || ' vs ' || coalesce(threshold,'?') || ' -> ' || action AS text FROM judgements WHERE action <> 'started' ORDER BY at
SELECT started*1000 AS time, 'start ' || name AS text FROM runs UNION ALL SELECT finished*1000, coalesce(verdict,'ended') || ' ' || name FROM runs WHERE finished IS NOT NULL

panels.title: Cost per run, cumulative
panels.description: Where a line stops, an annotation says why. The threshold is limits.usd_per_run.

targets.queryText: SELECT e.at*1000 AS time, r.name AS metric, (SELECT sum(json_extract(e2.payload,'$.usd')) FROM events e2 WHERE e2.run=e.run AND e2.kind='spend' AND e2.at<=e.at) AS value FROM events e JOIN runs r ON r.run=e.run WHERE e.kind='spend' ORDER BY e.at

panels.title: Turns per minute, by phase
panels.description: A flat line inside a live run is a turn that has not come back.

targets.queryText: SELECT CAST(at/60 AS INTEGER)*60000 AS time, coalesce(phase,'no phase') AS metric, count(*) AS value FROM events WHERE kind='turn' GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Phases and branches
panels.description: What was running when. A gap is time the pipeline was neither working nor stopping.

targets.queryText: SELECT CAST(at/60 AS INTEGER)*60000 AS time, coalesce(nullif(branch,''),'head') AS metric, coalesce(phase, agent, '?') AS value FROM events WHERE kind IN ('turn','log','session_start') GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1
SELECT at*1000 AS time, coalesce(agent,'?') AS metric, json_extract(payload,'$.seconds') AS value FROM events WHERE kind='session_end' ORDER BY at
SELECT at*1000 AS at, scope, coalesce(subject,'') AS subject, rule, threshold, observed, action, coalesce(outcome,'') AS outcome FROM judgements ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 200

SELECT started*1000 AS started, name, coalesce(verdict,'running') AS verdict, CAST((coalesce(finished, strftime('%s','now')) - started)/60 AS INTEGER) AS minutes, ROUND(coalesce(usd,0),2) AS usd, coalesce(turns,0) AS turns, coalesce(summary,'') AS summary FROM runs ORDER BY started DESC LIMIT 50
